trip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:trip.com San Francisco United States 1-star hotel average nightly price
trip_one_star_average.reason: The Trip.com-restricted results returned generic San Francisco pages and 3-star/5-star price snippets, but no exact-city 1-star nightly statistic. Other-class and generic values were rejected.

hotelscombined_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:hotelscombined.com San Francisco United States 1-star hotel average nightly price
hotelscombined_one_star_average.reason: HotelsCombined returned generic city averages, budget/other-class trends, and a single 1-star property (Winsor Hotel) with a cheapest/from-style price. No city-wide 1-star statistic qualified; property and overall values were rejected.

budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip current hotel-price analysis; 5 1-star hotels; prices before taxes and fees; result crawled last month (July 2026)
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in San Francisco? Hotel Prices for San Francisco, California | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: The average price of the 5 terrific 1-star hotels in San Francisco is $73, and the median price is $65.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com San Francisco United States 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: The Budget Your Trip result identifies San Francisco and 1-star hotels and reports a numeric average nightly price in USD. It does not state two adults and one room, so occupancy remains unknown; the separately reported median was not substituted or averaged.
